facts.text: I am trying to get organized with my jewelry collection.
I want jewelry storage cases or boxes to keep my pieces from getting tangled or lost.
I plan to check out the Songmics Stackable Jewelry Box.
I lost my favorite silver necklace with a small diamond pendant three weeks ago on a Friday evening.
I lost the necklace while I was getting ready for dinner at a new Italian place downtown.
I plan to retrace my steps and ask around to see if anyone has seen the necklace.
I plan to post about the lost necklace on social media.
I plan to ask my friends to share the social media post.
I plan to contact the restaurant again to ask if they have a lost and found section.
I plan to ask the restaurant if anyone has turned in a necklace like mine.
I plan to call the restaurant again to ask about their lost and found section.
I plan to ask the restaurant if they have security cameras that might have caught someone picking up the necklace.
I plan to ask the restaurant about their security cameras.
I plan to ask the restaurant about policies or procedures for handling lost and found items, such as a log or a dedicated person in charge.
